Yoshino Aoyama (Japanese: 青山吉能 Aoyama Yoshino) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Aoyama was born on May 15, 1996 and is affiliated with . Aoyama became a voice actor in 2014 and joined the during , voicing Dot and her internet persona Nidothing.
